craft_evidence.owned: NONE found: no factory, mill or workshop claimed on supreme.com or us.supreme.com (about page renders only "EST 1994. NYC."; FAQ silent on making) — evidence of absence, not of ownership
craft_evidence.makers: NONE: no clothing PDP read (27) names a maker; Hanes, New Era, Nike, Rita Ackermann are co-brand/collaboration partners, not named makers ("Made exclusively for Supreme" on the Nike AF1)
craft_evidence.mills: NONE: generic cloth only ("All cotton 13 oz. selvedge denim", "Pertex poly", "GORE-TEX 2-Layer poly ripstop"); no cloth or yarn mill named
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated and placed but minimal (claim): site meta "EST 1994. NYC."; no founding story on pages that render without script. Lafayette Street 1994 founding is from press (Vice 2018), not the brand
craft_evidence.process: Spec-level only (claim): weights and constructions on PDPs ("13 oz.", "brushed-back fleece", "down filled quilted baffles", "quilted taffeta lining"); no account of how or where made
craft_evidence.reasoning: Of 27 clothing PDPs read on the live shop (2026-10-10), one (Slim Straight Selvedge Jean) states a country ("Made in Japan"); none names a maker or mill, and the rest give only "All cotton" or a cloth name. The brand site claims no facility and publishes no making process; "EST 1994. NYC." is the only heritage line it carries. Nothing checkable about making beyond that, so 1 (2 arguable on the one Made-in line).

ownership.owner: EssilorLuxottica SA (Euronext Paris: EL), acquired from VF Corporation, closed 2 October 2024 for $1.5bn cash base price
